patch_description: Restructure the routing into a modular CandidateRouter that, for each destination, computes the Dijkstra baseline path (exact fallback, guaranteeing correctness) and compares it against a small set of k-shortest candidate paths. A candidate is adopted only if it is strictly cheaper than the Dijkstra baseline (one-sided greedy improvement), minimizing risk while opening the door to lower-cost routes through multi-hop network paths. Dijkstra results are cached so shared destinations are never recomputed, and edge costs are read from a single safe accessor that tolerates missing cost data. This keeps the output format identical while reducing total transfer cost wherever cheaper alternate paths exist.
